zh: 小李，下周二 10 月 6 日去上海。
en: Li, we are going to Shanghai next Tuesday, October 6.

zh: 下午在国家会展中心洲际酒店见吉利汽车王总，聊合作方案。
en: We will meet Mr. Wang from Geely at the InterContinental Shanghai NECC in the afternoon to discuss the cooperation proposal.

zh: 下周二下午两点跟王总碰一下，你看看这个时间有没有冲突？
en: We are meeting Mr. Wang next Tuesday at 2 p.m. Could you check for any scheduling conflicts?

zh: 没问题就安排上。
en: Schedule it if there are no conflicts.

zh: 酒店还没订吧？
en: The hotel has not been booked yet, right?

zh: 找个离国家会展中心近一点的，别超过八百。
en: Find a hotel near the National Exhibition and Convention Center for no more than CNY 800 per night.

zh: 先别订，我还没确定住几晚。
en: Do not book yet. I have not decided how many nights to stay.

zh: 这个客户主要做哪块业务？
en: What is this client’s main line of business?

zh: 见面之前帮我整理一页背景，放飞书里。
en: Prepare a one-page background brief before the meeting and put it in Feishu.

zh: 方案你先发王总看看，邮件里说明还在讨论，别写成最终报价。
en: Send Mr. Wang the proposal for review. Say it is still under discussion, not a final quotation.

zh: 邮件先存草稿，我看过再发。
en: Save the email as a draft first and send it after I review it.

zh: 收到，我先整理资料和会前清单。
en: Got it. I will organize the information and the meeting checklist first.

zh: “城市回声”上海演唱会周五开票！
en: Tickets for the City Echo concert in Shanghai go on sale on Friday!

zh: 还有，今晚去上海音乐厅听室内乐，别跑错地方啦。
en: Also, we are going to Shanghai Concert Hall for chamber music tonight. Make sure you go to the right venue.

zh: 周五中午十二点开票，记得提前十分钟提醒我，别又忙忘了。
en: Tickets go on sale at noon on Friday. Remind me ten minutes early so I do not forget.

zh: 今晚不想做饭了，附近有没有清淡一点的？
en: I do not feel like cooking tonight. Is there anything light nearby?

zh: 想喝粥，再点两个小菜。
en: I would like some congee and two side dishes.

zh: 我快下班了，能帮我叫辆车去音乐厅吗？
en: I am about to finish work. Could you book a ride to the concert hall?

zh: 想六点半之前到。
en: I would like to arrive before 6:30 p.m.

zh: 你看这个包日常背会不会太大？
en: Do you think this bag is too big for everyday use?

zh: 有没有小一号的，最好也有这个颜色？
en: Is there a smaller size, preferably in the same color?

zh: 这个颜色挺好看。
en: This color looks nice.

zh: 尺寸我帮你看看。
en: I will check the dimensions for you.

zh: 车已经叫好了，到了给我发微信就行。
en: The ride is already booked. Just message me on WeChat when you arrive.

zh: 我们办公室在上海市娄山关路 88 号。
en: Our office is at 88 Loushanguan Road, Shanghai.

zh: 方案名为“合作方案 v2”。
en: The proposal is “Cooperation Draft v2”.

zh: 从虹桥站到你们办公室，怎么走最方便？
en: What’s the easiest way to get from Hongqiao Station to your office?

zh: 你能把位置发给我吗？
en: Could you send me the location?

zh: 你现在方便简短通话吗？
en: Are you free for a quick call?

zh: 我想确认方案中的两个问题。
en: I’d like to clarify two points in the proposal.

zh: 样品费为人民币 300 元，另加运费 30 元。
en: The sample fee is CNY 300, plus CNY 30 shipping.

zh: 运单引用：SF-DEMO-0930。
en: Reference: SF-DEMO-0930.

zh: Alex 的通话联系人已保存。
en: Alex’s call contact is saved.

zh: 样品已经寄出了吗？
en: Have the samples been shipped yet?

zh: 你能把物流信息发给我吗？
en: Could you send me the tracking details?

zh: 含运费的样品费用一共是多少？
en: How much is the sample fee, including shipping?

zh: 请把费用明细和付款信息发给我。
en: Send me the breakdown and payment details, please.

zh: 我会查看物流，然后把明细发给你。
en: I’ll check the shipment and send you a breakdown.

zh: 谢谢，这很有帮助。
en: Thanks, that helps.
Use Shanghai time for the meeting; the end time is still awaiting confirmation.
zh: 会议按上海当地时间安排，结束时间等王总确认。

en: Set a reminder for thirty minutes before the meeting; wait for my confirmation before sending invitations.
zh: 会前提醒先设提前半小时，邀请等我确认后再发。

en: Save the hotel search criteria first; convenient transport matters more than breakfast.
zh: 酒店先保留筛选条件，交通方便比早餐更重要。

en: Add the check-in and check-out dates after the itinerary is confirmed; compare locations for now.
zh: 等行程确定后再补入住和退房日期，现在先比较位置。

en: Cite the sources in the client brief and leave unverified figures blank.
zh: 客户背景要注明资料来源，暂时没有核实的数据先空着。

en: Put the discussion topics and open questions in the same Feishu meeting brief.
zh: 会前清单加上合作议题和待确认问题，放在同一份飞书文档里。

en: The recipient email and final attachment are not available yet; leave them blank in the draft.
zh: 收件人邮箱和最终附件还没给你，草稿里先留空。

en: Mark the email as a discussion draft and do not promise prices or delivery dates.
zh: 邮件标题标明讨论稿，正文不要承诺价格或交付日期。

en: Keep the ticket sale reminder separate from tonight’s concert hall visit.
zh: 开票提醒别和今晚去音乐厅的安排混在一起。

en: Check the concert sessions and seats first; do not buy tickets before confirmation.
zh: 演唱会场次和座位先看看，没确认之前先不买票。

en: Keep dinner light and check the menu first; there is no rush to order.
zh: 晚饭还是清淡一点，先看看菜单，不用急着下单。

en: I will send the delivery address later; note down what we want to eat first.
zh: 收餐地址我晚点发你，先把想吃的记下来。

en: The ride is already booked; do not book another one and send your location after leaving.
zh: 车已经叫好，不用重复下单，出发后发我位置。

en: We still need to reach Shanghai Concert Hall before six thirty; check the route in advance.
zh: 还是六点半前到上海音乐厅，路线可以提前看看。

en: I like this patchwork colour scheme; look for a smaller bag in the same colours.
zh: 喜欢这个拼接配色，先找同色小号款看看。

en: The image does not show the actual size; check the dimensions and strap length before buying.
zh: 图片看不出真实尺寸，买之前要核对长宽高和肩带长度。

en: Please keep the destination as 88 Loushanguan Road.
zh: 目的地请保持为娄山关路 88 号。

en: Compare public transport and driving before we choose a route.
zh: 我们选路线前，先比较公共交通和驾车。

en: Please list the two open questions before the call.
zh: 请在通话前列出那两个待确认问题。

en: We can use WeChat for the call; no need to dial a new number.
zh: 我们可以用微信通话，不需要拨打新号码。

en: Please check the tracking reference before sharing an update.
zh: 分享进展前，请先核对运单引用。

en: If the delivery status is not verified, leave it unconfirmed in the draft.
zh: 如果配送状态未经核实，在草稿里保留为待确认。

en: Please list the sample fee and shipping separately in the breakdown.
zh: 请在费用明细里分开列出样品费和运费。

en: Draft the payment note first; I will confirm the payment details later.
zh: 先起草付款说明，我稍后确认收款信息。
王晨是这次对接人，吉利汽车商务经理，电话 13800138000。
en: Wang Chen is our contact, a business manager at Geely Auto. His phone number is 13800138000.

zh: 帮我存一下，备注“上海会展对接”。
en: Please save this contact with the note “Shanghai exhibition liaison”.

zh: 10月6日下午2点到3点，和吉利汽车王总在国家会展中心洲际酒店开会。
en: Meet Mr. Wang from Geely Auto at the InterContinental Shanghai NECC on October 6, from 2 to 3 p.m.

zh: 帮我记进日历，提前30分钟提醒。
en: Please add it to my calendar and remind me 30 minutes beforehand.

zh: 帮我记一下：查公司背景、整理讨论稿，出发前确认交通和住宿。
en: Please note these tasks: research the company, prepare the discussion draft, and confirm transport and accommodation before departure.

zh: 今晚不想做饭了，想喝粥，再点两个清淡小菜。
en: I don’t feel like cooking tonight. I’d like congee and two light side dishes.

zh: 先看看菜单，不用急着下单。
en: Let’s look at the menu first; there’s no rush to order.

zh: 好，我先记菜单，等你发地址。
en: OK, I’ll note the menu and wait for your address.

zh: 现在方便用微信简单聊一下吗？
en: Are you free for a quick WeChat call?

zh: 物流状态和收款资料还需要确认。
en: The tracking status and payment details still need confirmation.

zh: 先起草费用明细；收款资料我稍后确认。
en: Draft the breakdown first; I will confirm the payment details later.

zh: 收到。
en: Got it.

zh: 好的。
en: Okay.

zh: 嗯嗯。
en: Mm-hmm.

zh: 明白啦。
en: Understood.

zh: 没错。
en: Exactly.

zh: 好吧。
en: All right.

zh: 是的。
en: Yes.

zh: 谢谢。
en: Thank you.

zh: 哈哈哈哈。
en: Hahaha.

zh: 嘿嘿。
en: Hehe.

zh: 嗯嗯，好。
en: Mm-hmm, okay.

zh: 好哒。
en: Okey-dokey.

zh: 知道啦。
en: Got it, thanks.

zh: 好。
en: Okay.

zh: 哈哈。
en: Haha.

zh: 嗯，好的。
en: Sure.

zh: 是的呀。
en: Yep.

zh: 听起来不错。
en: Sounds good.

zh: 哈哈，行。
en: Haha, okay.

zh: 嗯，好吧。
en: Mm, all right.

zh: 周末从上海去苏州拙政园逛逛吧，想先了解园林，再看看门票和路线。
en: Let's visit the Humble Administrator's Garden in Suzhou from Shanghai this weekend, and check its introduction, tickets and route first.

zh: 哈哈，好呀。
en: Haha, sounds good.

zh: 周五中午十二点开票。
en: Tickets go on sale at noon on Friday.

zh: 记得提前十分钟提醒我，别又忙忘了。
en: Please remind me ten minutes beforehand so I do not forget while I am busy.
